items.title: "Papa Jack" Laine and Alfred Laine Interview, 1951-04-21
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] uh, uh, most of the men down here affectionately call you Mama Lane?

ctx.x: I see. Uh, Mrs. Lane, would you say one or two words for us first? Isn't, isn't your wife's brother? No, cousin. Uh, uh, uh, uh, uh,

uh, uh, most of the men down here affectionately call you Mama Lane? Yes, uh, Yes, and, uh, uh, isn't it also true that you had a finger in the pie for the firemen around here? I made every shirt they wore. How many sometimes?
I made 42 shirts when they started.
